text:
maria: Heads-up: perf/latency/batched CI is red after the optimizer merge. 99th tail for long-context quant workloads jumped ~3x. Repro locally with perf-runner.
devon: confirmed on my workstation, looks like kernel scoring picks slower kernels when KV cache hit ratio drops. kv eviction pattern changed by the new heuristic.
sam: CI bot posted failures:
ci-bot: perf/latency/batched (linux-gpu) — failed — median +15%, p99 +300% — log: https://ci/reports/2007/evict-kernel-fail.txt
maria: minimal repro steps: run tools/perf/run_latency.py --model llama-13b --seq 2048 --profile long-context. you'll see batch latency spike after ~1200 tokens.
devon: bisected to commit abcdef1 from PR #4890 (optimizer: kernel-score tweak + soft-evict).
olivia: hmm, that PR also changed the threshold used by KV cache eviction. Could be interacting with kernel selector's fallback scoring.
ryan: idea: revert the soft-evict part only, keep kernel scoring tweak. Doable as a targeted cherry-pick?
sam: I can craft a revert PR for the soft-evict lines and run perf CI. target branch: release-1.12-hotfix.
release-manager: hold cuts: we won't cut release-1.12.1 until this is verified. schedule patch window for next 2 hours.
maria: thanks. Once sam has PR, can someone run the perf-runner against canary hardware (A100) and the CI distributed job? Need to match cloud config.
devon: I'll run a quick canary on a small fleet (`./scripts/canary-run.sh --tag canary-evict`) and post numbers.
ci-bot: Started job perf/canary/evict-test — see https://ci/canary/200702. Will post artifacts.
sam: created PR #4921: hotfix: revert soft-evict threshold (cherry-pick abcdef1^-1) -> hotfix/evict-threshold-1.12. patch: `git cherry-pick -x <commit>` then drop the soft-evict hunks.
olivia: pinging infra to make sure we pin the kernel selector config during test. @devon can you add a config override?
devon: added override: `selectors.kernels.strict_scoring=false` for canary run to keep selector deterministic. pushing logs in 10m.
ryan: QA: after CI passes, we should backport to release-1.12 (cherry-pick PR) and then roll out canary to 10% of production pods with fallback to older model variant.
sam: CI green on perf canary, p99 back to baseline on A100. Posting raw numbers: baseline p99=210ms, bad p99=720ms, hotfix p99=225ms.
maria: awesome. can we get one more run with longer tail (seq 4096)? run started.
ci-bot: perf/canary/evict-test-4096 — passed. artifacts: https://ci/artifacts/200702/evict-4096.zip
release-manager: LGTM from release side. I'll merge hotfix PR into release-1.12-hotfix branch after final checks and tag for X.1.
olivia: I'll prepare the rollout plan: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10-minute SLO checks and auto-fallback. Add rollout note to console.
maria: thanks everyone. follow-up: open follow-up ticket to rework eviction heuristic to avoid kernel-selector inversion and add unit test for scoring interplay. created issue INF-1287.
devon: noted, will pick up INF-1287 after this release cut. :thumbsup:
